in_marathi.name: Dhruvesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे He who brings prosperity and wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruv means 'he who is fixed' and Ish means 'god'. Dhruvesh is a name for the god of wealth, Indra. It is a powerful name that is believed to bring prosperity and wealth to the bearer.
